title: 兼容检索请求
explanation: 前端不直接调用此内部能力；业务后端或Agent Runtime以冻结Schema调用。

title: pgvector余弦检索
code:
SELECT chunk_id, 1 - (embedding <=> :query_vector) AS similarity
FROM knowledge_chunks_ext
WHERE knowledge_base_version_id = :version_id
ORDER BY embedding <=> :query_vector
LIMIT :top_k;
explanation: 查询向量与文档向量必须使用相同模型、维度和归一化配置。

title: RRF融合伪代码
explanation: RRF按排名而不是异构原始分数融合；候选池和k仍需评测。

title: 不可覆盖权限过滤
explanation: 可信后端字段最后覆盖，Agent不能扩大组织和安全权限。

title: 审核结果分支
code:
match review.review_result:
    case "approved": publish(resource)
    case "needs_revision": retry_generation(review.repair_instructions)
    case "rejected": block_cycle()
    case "human_required": create_human_review()
explanation: 审核业务结果与Agent运行成功状态分开记录。

title: MRR计算
code: mrr = sum(0 if rank is None else 1.0 / rank for rank in first_relevant_ranks) / len(first_relevant_ranks)
explanation: MRR关注第一个相关结果的位置，需和Recall/nDCG一起使用。

title: 受控Agentic RAG状态边
code:
routes:
  - from: evidence_check
    when: sufficient
    to: generation
  - from: evidence_check
    when: insufficient and retries < 2
    to: retrieval
  - from: evidence_check
    when: insufficient
    to: abstain_or_human
explanation: 工作流边由代码和策略冻结，模型只提供结构化判断。

title: 权限安全的检索缓存键
explanation: 缓存键必须包含版本、权限过滤、策略和参数，防止过期或越权复用。
